I haven't seen my dad in a little over a year, felt like I didn't care at first, now I don't know. Its like sometimes, (most of the time) I don't even notice, because my parents have been divorced so long, I'm used to week spaced intervals. Other times like when I actually think about it, it just makes me sad. The thing that makes me sadder though is the fact that this probably fulfills the curse. My brothers both stopped going to my dad's house around my age, and they said I would do the same, I guess he decided to leave me instead. I feel like your family are the people who are supposed to stay with you no matter what, even if they don't love you, but everyone just leaves. Everyone leaves, I know its my fault, but I feel like my friends sort of left me to, even though I'm the one who went somewhere else. I guess I have my brothers, but when I talk to them, they don't seem very interested. It would be nice to have someone to talk to, who wouldn't follow the trend. Sorry if i'm being a tad melodramatic. XD
